decided: 2026-10-23 - Khalid: archive option B ("2archive lets do B"): protect only data that cannot be re-downloaded, like the provider history on data.html, and skip files the engines rebuild every day; measure the saving per folder before changing anything
status: NOT APPLIED - measured by ops 6632 (-$15.18/month now, -$23.04 averaged over a year), but the exclusion mechanism does not exist: a Disabled higher-priority rule did not stop its prefix from being copied (canary, 4.3 min in ops 6633 and 20 min in ops 6636; configuration restored both times). Kept as the reviewed list for an include-list implementation (ops 6634/6635 would need rewriting for it) if Khalid chooses one; the archive copies the whole bucket.
mechanism: The base rule keeps copying the whole bucket, so a new folder is archived by default. Each excluded prefix gets its own replication rule with Status Disabled and a priority above the base rule: when several rules with the same destination match a key, S3 applies the highest-priority one, and a disabled rule replicates nothing. Proven on a canary prefix before use (ops 6633). Copies already in the archive stay (only the root user can delete there).

principle.keep: provider history (data/warm, data/providers data, symbology, ECB, CISS), point-in-time originals a provider will not serve again (option chains, ETF constituents, market internals, futures catalogs ...), original provider bytes (data/evidence), every history/ledger/vintage file, every top-level data/*.json file (several carry their own history), and anything not proven rebuildable
principle.exclude: (1) captures of provider data the provider serves again for any past date, when nothing else depends on the exact old bytes being kept; (2) research packets a pure compiler rebuilds from originals that stay archived; (3) engine caches, indexes and catalog listings rebuilt from other stored data
principle.threshold: only folders costing the archive at least ~$0.05/month or growing it at least ~1 GB/month are listed; smaller ones stay archived because the saving is not worth the review
principle.rewritten_is_not_rebuilt: a history file rewritten daily with one more observation is still history and stays archived; only outputs recomputed from other data are excluded
